name: Molnar Roofing Inc.

domains.result: The root page is a small GoDaddy parking stub whose script sends the browser to /lander; that ends on a third-party article/ad page that returns an Akamai 'Access Denied' error (title 'Access Denied', reference #18.92292117.1794597636.246dea5). Identical at 1280 px desktop and 390 px phone width; http:// and the www. host serve the same stub. No certificate warning was shown, so HTTPS itself is not the failure.

likely_cause.reasoning: The registration is current (expires 2027-08-06, registrar GoDaddy, client delete/renew/transfer holds in place) and the creation date of 2008 matches a long-standing business, so the name does not look lost or re-registered by a stranger. It sits on GoDaddy's own nameservers (NS21/NS22.DOMAINCONTROL.COM) and the served page is GoDaddy's parking lander: the archived 17 Jul 2026 copy of the homepage loads GoDaddy 'parking-lander' scripts and sets LANDER_SYSTEM to 'PW', and the live lander URL carries trafficTarget=gd. Wayback shows the real GoDaddy Website Builder site still live on 13 Nov 2025 and the parking lander by 17 Jul 2026, so the website or hosting plan that sat on the domain was taken down or lapsed while the domain stayed registered. Recorded as inference: no source states why.

fix_steps.step: Log in to the GoDaddy account that holds molnarroofinginc.com and check two separate things: the domain registration (current, paid to Aug 2027) and any website builder/hosting plan on it. Restore or renew the website plan, or point the domain at new hosting. Keep the domain renewal on auto-renew with a working billing email.
fix_steps.who: Owner, with whoever set the site up on the phone

fix_steps.step: Publish a simple one-page site on the domain: what they do (roof replacement, repair, slate, gutters), service area, phone, hours, a few job photos and licensing note. The old site's text can be reused from the archived copy at web.archive.org (written by the business, so it is theirs to reuse).

Update the Google Business Profile: replace or confirm the website link, add hours (the profile currently shows 'Add hours'), add services and photos, confirm the service area. Google verifies some edits, so allow a few days.
fix_steps.who: Owner (profile owner) or web person given access

fix_steps.step: Claim or correct the other listings that repeat the old details and link: the CLAD Siding listing links molnarroofinginc.com, and the Birdeye profile (4.8, 5 reviews) is shown as unclaimed. Correct the website field once the new site is live.
Add a simple check that warns them if the domain or site stops responding (an uptime monitor plus a calendar reminder before each renewal), and retest the Google website link afterwards on a phone.

after_fix.opportunity: Add a short quote-request form (name, address, what is wrong with the roof, photo upload) so a homeowner can ask for an estimate outside working hours, with the form sending to the owner's email.
after_fix.evidence: The Google profile lists only a phone number, plus a street address; there is no site and no form on any listing I could read, so a homeowner with a leak at 8 p.m. has no written way to ask for a quote.

severity_reason: The only website link a customer is likely to click -- the one on the Google profile -- ends on a third-party 'Access Denied' page, and there is no other site carrying the business's services, hours or photos, so a homeowner gets nothing to read and has to call.
audit_md:
# Website Health Check: Molnar Roofing Inc.

**What we saw on 13 November 2026**

- molnarroofinginc.com, the site on their Google profile, shows no website: a GoDaddy parking page passes visitors to a third-party ad page that returns "Access Denied".
- Same result at desktop and 390 px phone width (screenshots taken). The registration is paid to 6 August 2027; no certificate warning appears.
- The Google profile still lists that domain, with 513 3rd Ave, North Brunswick Township, NJ 08902, (732) 846-0466, a 5.0 rating and no hours.
- An archived copy shows their real site live on 13 November 2025, so it went offline within the past year.

**What it means for customers**

A homeowner who taps "website" on the Google profile reaches an error page with no services, photos or form. The phone number is the only working route from that profile.

**How to fix it**

1. In the GoDaddy account, confirm the domain (paid to 2027) and check the website/hosting plan on it, then restore or renew it. Owner, with whoever built the site: 0.5-1.5 h.
2. Put a one-page site back: services, slate work, service area, phone, hours, photos. Web person: 3-6 h.
3. Update the Google profile: website link, hours, services, photos. Owner or web person: 0.5-1 h.
4. Correct listings that copy the link (CLAD Siding) and claim the unclaimed Birdeye profile. Web person: 1-2 h.
5. Add an uptime check and renewal reminders, then retest the Google link on a phone. Web person: 0.5-1 h.

**After the fix**

Add a short quote-request form so a homeowner can ask for an estimate in writing; today the profile offers only a phone call.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.

# Founder notes: Molnar Roofing Inc. (B00875)

**Outreach email draft**

Subject: The website link on your Google listing currently shows an error

Hi Steve,

I looked up Molnar Roofing on Google today and the website link on your listing goes through a parking page to an "Access Denied" screen, so anyone checking you out sees nothing about your roofing work. Your domain itself is still registered to 2027 on GoDaddy, which suggests the problem is the website or hosting attached to it rather than a lost domain. I saved screenshots of what a customer sees on a desktop and on a phone, and I can walk you through them plus the handful of steps that would put a page back on that address -- would a short call or a visit to 513 3rd Ave suit you?

**Walk-in / phone opener**

Hi, I'm local -- the website link on your Google listing currently lands on an error page, and I have phone screenshots of it if you want to see them.

**Sources**

- Live domain test (both screenshots taken today): https://molnarroofinginc.com/ -- http://, https:// and the www host all serve the same stub
- Google Business Profile with the website link, address, phone and "Add hours": https://www.google.com/maps/place/Molnar+Roofing+Inc/@40.4683503,-74.4479622,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x89c3c67c201ffef9:0x358a52857264f48!8m2!3d40.4683503!4d-74.4479622!16s%2Fg%2F1tdrg9f9
- RDAP registration record (registered 2008-08-06, expires 2027-08-06, last changed 2022-09-12, GoDaddy, GoDaddy nameservers): https://rdap.org/domain/molnarroofinginc.com
- Archived site live on 13 Nov 2025: https://web.archive.org/web/20251113060336/https://www.molnarroofinginc.com/
- Archived parking lander on the domain, 17 Jul 2026: https://web.archive.org/web/20260717115842/https://molnarroofinginc.com/
- Wayback index for the domain: http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=molnarroofinginc.com&output=json
- CLAD Siding listing with molnarroofinginc.com and (732) 846-0466: https://www.cladsiding.com/contractors/new-jersey/north-brunswick-township/molnar-roofing-inc/
- Birdeye profile, unclaimed, 4.8 from 5 reviews, address: https://reviews.birdeye.com/molnar-roofing-inc-165459006575678
- BestProsInTown reviews (Dec 2019, Jun 2017): https://www.bestprosintown.com/nj/north-brunswick/molnar-roofing-inc-/

**Open questions**

- Who holds the GoDaddy login for the domain, and is the website/hosting plan still attached to it (lapsed, cancelled or deleted)?
- Did they stop the site on purpose, and does Steve want a site again or only a Google listing?
- Is (732) 846-0466 still the number he answers, and does he want a quote form sending to an email address?
- Is the business taking new work at this pace (no review newer than 2019 was visible to us)?
caveats: The likely cause is an inference: no source states why the site came off the domain. The evidence is a current registration to 2027, GoDaddy nameservers, a GoDaddy parking lander, a live site on 13 Nov 2025 and a parking lander by 17 Jul 2026.
Status is 'operating' because the Google profile, address and phone listings are live; I did not find a review or job dated 2025-2026, so current trading is not independently confirmed.
The 'Access Denied' screen comes from a third-party page the parking service sends traffic to, so the exact wording a customer sees may vary between visits or locations.
Effort hours are estimates, not quotes, and no prices are given.
data_gaps: Yelp page (linked from the CLAD Siding listing) returned an empty page in the browser and HTTP 403 to a plain fetch, so I could not check whether it links the domain.

YellowPages and BuildZoom both returned bot-block pages (Cloudflare) to the browser; RoofingDirect and middlesexsouthmoms.com returned HTTP 403, so those listings could not be checked for a website link.
Google profile was in a limited view: review text and review dates were not readable, and hours are absent from the profile.
No registrar account or billing information is visible publicly; whether a website/hosting plan still exists on the domain can only be seen by the owner.
No public confirmation of jobs or reviews after 2019 was found.
